source: GuildOrder WoW Forever talent pages (reviewed Oct 2026) reconciled with Blizzard beta development notes updated Nov 2, 2026
notes: DRAFT assembled by hand on 2026-11-03; NOT read from the game client. Base: GuildOrder WoW Forever talent pages (reviewed October 2026). Changes: Blizzard 'WoW Forever Beta Development Notes - Updated November 2'. Limits: talent-to-talent prerequisites are only those the notes state (the source shows none); 'column' is list order, not the real grid position; percentage-only changes are not modelled; tree contents were relayed through a page-summarising tool, so transcription errors are possible. Builds can be checked against this data but can never be marked verified.
